run_rag_pipeline: run a retrieval augmented generation pipeline with vLLM and LlamaIndex to query web documents
create_rag_index: create a Milvus vector store index from web page documents using LlamaIndex
load_web_documents: load and process web documents from a URL using SimpleWebPageReader with HTML-to-text conversion
query_rag_index: query a RAG index with a question and top-k parameter to retrieve answers from indexed documents
configure_rag_models: configure embedding and chat models via OpenAI-compatible endpoints with LlamaIndex Settings
